searchText: exiting and re-entering involves waiting months for my ETH to be unlocked and then waiting in the queue to re-enter... that is a very expensive way of changing my keys. I understand that it's not trivial to do (to change the key without stopping validation), just saying that it would be a good feature from a security perspective. What attack are you attempting to mitigate? How do you get to the "months"? Isn't it more like 2 days? I think he is referring to the fact that now his ETH is locked so if he were to attempt an exit it would take until withdrawals are implemented to actually be able to take his ETH out and then redeposit. <@!202397237962211328> this kind of change anyway won't be there (if ever) before withdrawals are implemented, so for all practical purposes validator rotation would take just a couple of days and not months.
